verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing batch-style automation, not a dedicated bulk-operations capability. /qa iteratively fixes many bugs with an atomic commit for each, /autoplan runs several review skills in sequence with auto-decisions, and /learn can prune or export accumulated learnings. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk or batch operation across many items (e.g. multiple repos, files, PRs or pages at once), documentation of parallel or multi-target execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
